title: R&M — STAND (PF Olsen): additional real forest blocks found in the full 4,024-row raw log (Phase 2 import prep)
notes: Wave 1 seeded 3 zones (Rabbit Island, Borlace Forest [unplaced], Howard Forest) from the List sheet's 3 documented Forest Name/Code pairs - but that List sheet is a GL billing-code reference, same gap already found for M&R. Exporting the full 4,024-row ACTIVE sheet and counting distinct Forest codes found 15 more codes in real use. This wave: (1) directly UPDATEd the long-outstanding Borlace Forest zone (id 8ade47c4-9a15-482e-a850-770bd0b02af6) with a real geocode found via linz-lookup this time (Borlase Avenue, St Arnaud area) - not part of this seed file, done as a targeted SQL UPDATE since the zone already existed under a different external_ref than this file's key scheme; (2) adds 4 new confidently-geocoded zones (SHER/Sherry River, LINK/Linkwater on Queen Charlotte Drive, RICH/near the Nelson Lakes Gliding Club - Howard, TEET/Tee Total Road); (3) creates 4 more UNPLACED (named block only, no confident geocode after multiple linz-lookup attempts with varied phrasing) - SLIP/Slippery River (187 rows, meaningful volume but no match found), KAIN (also covers TUNN - both codes' Location text is 'Tunnicliffes Rd', treated as the same real place per the established 'same location text = same block, different code over time' pattern), MANU, FROR (a name already flagged in prior session memory as appearing in DATA but never resolved).
ALLF (143 rows) is confirmed a non-place administrative code ('All Facilities', Forest/Location both blank in the raw data) - deliberately left unmapped, matching NCC's ALLF precedent.

No 'agreement' key included deliberately - STAND's operational agreement already exists and is accepted from wave 1; new zones are linked to it via a direct SQL INSERT INTO service_agreement_locations after this seed applies (same pattern used for DOC/NCC/TDC/M&R/Taylors).
